description: This file implements the LifecycleManager class, handling application lifecycle events, registration of notifications, app spawning, state transitions, and event dispatching within a plugin framework. It manages loaded applications, responds to runtime and window manager events, and communicates with other components via registered callbacks.

classes.name: LifecycleManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements application lifecycle management, event dispatching, notification registration, and handling runtime and window manager events within the plugin framework.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the lifecycle manager with the provided service.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources and terminates the lifecycle manager.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for lifecycle events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event asynchronously to registered listeners.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Handles lifecycle events and notifies registered callbacks based on event type.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves information about currently loaded applications.

methods.name: IsAppLoaded
methods.description: Checks if an application with the given appId is loaded.

methods.name: SpawnApp
methods.description: Launches a new application asynchronously.

methods.name: SetTargetAppState
methods.description: Requests a state change for a specific app instance.

methods.name: UnloadApp
methods.description: Initiates a graceful shutdown of an app.

methods.name: KillApp
methods.description: Forcefully terminates an app instance.

methods.name: SendIntentToActiveApp
methods.description: Sends a navigation intent to an active app.

methods.name: AppReady
methods.description: Signals that an app is ready.

methods.name: StateChangeComplete
methods.description: Indicates completion of a state change.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Closes an app based on the specified close reason.

methods.name: onRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles events from the runtime manager.

methods.name: onWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles events from the window manager.

methods.name: onRippleEvent
methods.description: Handles ripple events (currently empty).

methods.name: onStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles state change events.

methods.name: notifyOnFailure
methods.description: Dispatches a failure notification event.
